content: River TypeScript client (Jun 2026) inserts jobs from Node (node-postgres/Prisma drivers) worked by Go workers - direction Node-to-Go only, no Go-to-TS working. For Node device-runners: Go worker enqueues job, calls Node runner over local HTTP/gRPC, Node reports back; or Node inserts followup jobs for Go. River docs riverqueue.com/docs/typescript.
